# checksum.txt: the move packet's checksum byte, as black-box test vectors.
# Made 2026-10-30 by a research session: the modern server's checksum function and its CRC
# were compiled unchanged in a scratch directory outside the tree (gcc -O1, x86-64 Linux) and
# called on the inputs below. The function's 1024-byte key table is NOT reproduced here
# (protocol.md, § The move checksum, the decision). The CRC lines were also checked against
# an independent bitwise CRC-16 written from the statement in protocol.md: they agree.
#
# Lines:
#   crc16 <input hex or -> <crc hex>        CRC-16: poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, msb first, xorout 0
#   chk <sequence> <body hex or -> <byte>    the checksum byte for a body and the packet's own
#                                            outgoing sequence (decimal, as an unsigned 32-bit)
#   sweep ...                                a digest over many sequences, so one wrong key byte shows
#
# Bodies: the bytes the checksum covers, i.e. the loss byte and the three delta usercmds.
#   00000d000d000d          loss 0, three idle commands of msec 13
#   0505002090010d000d000d  loss 5, cmd1 = pitch 0x2000 (45 deg) + forward 400 + msec 13,
#                           cmd2 and cmd3 unchanged from it (bits 0, msec 13)
#   a 60-byte and a 70-byte run (byte i = (i*37+11) & 255): the 70-byte one gives the same
#   bytes as the 60-byte one, because only the first 60 bytes are covered.
#   - (empty) and 0b (one byte): edge cases.
crc16 - ffff
crc16 313233343536373839 29b1
crc16 61 9d77
crc16 ffffffff 1d0f
chk 0 00000d000d000d 6c
chk 1 00000d000d000d 6e
chk 2 00000d000d000d 74
chk 255 00000d000d000d 59
chk 256 00000d000d000d e3
chk 1019 00000d000d000d 4d
chk 1020 00000d000d000d 40
chk 1021 00000d000d000d 42
chk 65535 00000d000d000d a6
chk 65536 00000d000d000d d2
chk 123456 00000d000d000d bb
chk 2147483647 00000d000d000d a4
chk 0 0505002090010d000d000d 58
chk 1 0505002090010d000d000d 5a
chk 2 0505002090010d000d000d 40
chk 255 0505002090010d000d000d 6d
chk 256 0505002090010d000d000d d7
chk 1019 0505002090010d000d000d 79
chk 1020 0505002090010d000d000d 74
chk 1021 0505002090010d000d000d 76

chk 65536 0505002090010d000d000d e6
chk 123456 0505002090010d000d000d 8f
chk 2147483647 0505002090010d000d000d 90
